command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=/tmp/omega777-central-boot-20260912T133100Z
REPO=$BASE/current
STATE=$BASE/state
if [ -e "$BASE" ]; then echo "FAIL existing_subject=$BASE"; exit 41; fi
LOAD=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)
MEM=$(awk '/MemAvailable:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
echo "OMEGA_BOOT_PREFLIGHT load1=$LOAD mem_available_kib=$MEM"
git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGA.git "$REPO"
HEAD=$(git -C "$REPO" rev-parse HEAD)
echo "OMEGA_BOOT_HEAD=$HEAD"
python3 -m venv "$BASE/venv"
. "$BASE/venv/bin/activate"
python -m pip install -q pytest
cd "$REPO"
python -m pytest -q
mkdir -p "$STATE" "$BASE/data"
export PYTHONPATH="$REPO" OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT="$STATE" OMEGA_REPO_ROOT="$REPO" OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB="$BASE/data/omega_unified.db"
nice -n 10 taskset -c 0-3 python -m omega.supervisor --runtime-root "$STATE" --repo-root "$REPO" >"$BASE/supervisor.stdout" 2>&1 &
SPID=$!
echo "OMEGA_BOOT_SUPERVISOR_PID=$SPID"
READY=0
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  if [ -s "$STATE/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json" ]; then
    READY=1; break
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo 'OMEGA_BOOT_FAIL no_status'; cat "$BASE/supervisor.stdout" || true; kill -TERM "$SPID" || true; wait "$SPID" || true; exit 42
fi
sleep 3
echo '===OMEGA_STATUS_LIVE==='
cat "$STATE/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json"
echo '===OMEGA_DB==='
python - <<'PY'
import os, sqlite3, json
p=os.environ['OMEGA_UNIFIED_DB']
out={'exists':os.path.exists(p),'bytes':os.path.getsize(p) if os.path.exists(p) else 0,'tables':[]}
if os.path.exists(p):
 c=sqlite3.connect(p); out['tables']=[r[0] for r in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table' order by name")]; c.close()
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
echo '===OMEGA_CHILD_PROCESSES==='
ps -o pid,ppid,stat,etime,cmd --ppid "$SPID" || true
kill -TERM "$SPID"
wait "$SPID" || RC=$?
RC=${RC:-0}
echo "OMEGA_BOOT_SUPERVISOR_EXIT=$RC"
echo '===OMEGA_STATUS_FINAL==='
cat "$STATE/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json"
python - <<'PY'
import json, os
p=os.environ['OMEGA_RUNTIME_ROOT']+'/SUPERVISOR_STATUS.json'
d=json.load(open(p))
alive={k:v.get('alive') for k,v in d['children'].items()}
print('OMEGA_BOOT_FINAL_CHILD_ALIVE='+json.dumps(alive,sort_keys=True))
PY
